sourceScope: Host-facing additions reuse immutable ready JSON definitions already in the PS4/PS5 download catalogue and F: archive. No new archive/source variants are substituted.
notes: JSON actions are Download/Save/setup only, never fabricated ELF/BIN Run actions.
PS4 CUSA files and native PS5 PPSA files stay separate; no backward-compatibility inference.
Game update and repository-definition revision are distinct; these files do not publish a separate menu release number.
Game artwork is illustrative and explicitly not a cheat-menu preview.

actions.label: Dead Island: Riptide - Definitive Edition cheats
actions.firmwareEvidence: The definition identifies a game build, not a numeric console-firmware support range. Match the native cheat manager to your firmware.
actions.imageRole: Game artwork; not a screenshot of this cheat menu.
actions.license: GPL-3.0 (repository licence; original contributor credits retained)
requirements: PS4 Dead Island: Riptide - Definitive Edition, title ID CUSA03290, exact game update 01.03. Do not use this file for another title ID or update.
Requires a homebrew-enabled PS4 running a compatible GoldHEN Cheat Menu. Native PS5 and PS4-on-PS5 support are not established for this exact PS4 definition.
Copy the unchanged ready JSON file as CUSA03290_01.03.json to /user/data/GoldHEN/cheats/json/ using FTP or the console file manager. Preserve any existing file before replacing it.
Open the matching game, then long-press Share or use the double-PS trigger configured in GoldHEN to open Cheat Menu. Select and enable individual cheats there.

Only one cheat format per title ID and game version is supported by the documented manager. This JSON is cheat data, not a standalone BIN/ELF payload or a full mod menu; downloading or saving it does not enable cheats.

Cheat conditions and contributor credits remain in the original JSON. Menu/trainer release version is not separately declared by the source; definition revision 3a4ca53414ed is recorded separately from the game update.
Static file and archive verification only; no console payload or cheat was executed.
